title: Rail8 system of an environment, schemaVersion 1 (draft — review at hand-over)
description: One system of an environment's configuration, as its export writes it and its import reads it, in a folder that is not a package, at system/<key>.yaml: the system's instance name in that environment, 1 to 128 printable characters. It holds no state: no revision, version, token, date, author or draft.
